The depth of field drop-off is extremely abrupt. The transition from the sharp meat texture to the pure white background happens within a few pixels, which can sometimes indicate AI-generated depth mapping errors, though it could also be a macro lens effect.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plasticity' of the red sauce. Real tomato glazes often have uneven thickness, small air bubbles, or separation of oils. AI generators often create a perfectly uniform, high-gloss polymer look. Also, verify if the internal flecks (onions/breadcrumbs) have distinct boundaries or if they smear into the meat matrix.
